label: globaltestlogin.vercel.app
title: Banco Promerica - Ingreso Seguro
reasons: The page impersonates Banco Promerica and requires the visitor to enter a 13-digit national identification number (DPI) under the pretext of 'ingreso seguro' (secure login).

After capturing the DPI, the page activates the camera to capture a facial photo (selfie) and submits both the DPI and the selfie to a Discord webhook (`https://discordapp.com/api/webhooks/...`) along with the visitor's IP address and geolocation obtained from multiple IP lookup services.
The page blocks developer tools (context menu, F12, Ctrl+Shift+I) to prevent inspection.
